issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for getters: The problem statement (and task text) asks students to "Implement getters for each attribute" which implies public accessor methods (problem_statement.md lines 30-36). The template file contains TODOs for adding getters/setters (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 4-18), leaving the expected signatures open. The solution implementation, however, declares getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() as private (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 22 and 30). This inconsistency can confuse students about the required visibility and may cause tests or student code that expect public getters to fail to compile or behave incorrectly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all attributes public in the solution implementation so they match the problem statement's requirement to "implement getters for each attribute". Specifically, change the signatures of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public. Also ensure the template's instructions or example signatures indicate public getters so students implement the correct visibility.
